description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945014375396 RELAY,SOLID STATE: Line 0001 Qty 34 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0064 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
